ruleDefinitions.name: DNS Server Discovery Via LDAP Query
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DNS server discovery via LDAP query requests from uncommon applications Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

sequences.query: QueryName = RGX("^\\_ldap\\\.") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "\<unknown\ process\>" OR process_path = "None") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\WindowsAzure\\\\GuestAgent") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$")))
